answer: One defence is a chained courier licence. To earn the right to trade, an agent must carry a marble token across a dune route, collecting a fresh stamp at each of five stops; the stamps chain together, so a copied token fails at the next stop. A raven checker replays one in ten routes in full and burns the licence of any agent whose stamps do not match. Running 200 clones therefore means 200 real crossings, 1000 genuine stamps and 10000 coins in licence bonds, with 50 coins burned per forged route, which costs far more than the trades a fake fleet could win.
